_note: 英語島文法分區（最後一批）：It is said that... / be said to 結構（eng.t_sub.voice.it-is-said，學測級）。It is said/believed/thought that + 子句；He is said to + 原形（同時）；He is said to have + p.p.（較早）；被動用 to have been + p.p.。形式依 Cambridge/Oxford/Swan，provisional，待英語母語 reviewer 複核。text-only shadowing、無音檔。

units.title_zh: It is said that… / be said to 結構
units.can_do: 我能用「It is said/believed that + 子句」報導大家的說法，也能改成「主詞 + be said to + 不定詞」：同時用 to + 原形（He is said to be rich），較早的事用 to have + 過去分詞（He is said to have been a hero）。
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'It is said/believed/thought/reported that + clause' is a way to report what people in general say, without naming who: 'It is said that the castle is very old.'
claims.verification_ref: It is said/believed that + 子句＝報導大家的說法，不點名誰；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: The same idea can be rewritten as 'Subject + is said to + base verb' when the two actions happen at the same time: 'It is said that she sings well.' = 'She is said to sing well.'
claims.verification_ref: be said to + 原形＝與報導同時（She is said to sing well）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: When the reported action is earlier, use 'to have + past participle': 'It is said that he was a hero.' = 'He is said to have been a hero.'
claims.verification_ref: 較早的事用 to have + 過去分詞（He is said to have been a hero）；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: In 'It is said that...', 'It' is an empty subject that just fills the grammar slot; it does not point to a thing.
claims.verification_ref: It is said that... 的 It 是形式主詞、不指任何東西；待英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: To report what people say in general, start with 'It is said/believed/thought that + a clause': 'It is said that the castle is very old.' Here 'It' is just an empty subject.
teach.zh_hint: 要報導「大家說…」又不點名是誰，用 It is said/believed/thought that + 子句：It is said that the castle is very old.（據說這座城堡很古老。）這裡的 It 只是形式主詞，不指任何東西。

teach.body: It is believed that the painting is a fake. It is reported that many people are safe.
teach.zh_hint: 據信這幅畫是贗品。報導指出許多人平安。believed、reported 也可以換 said、thought。

teach.body: The same sentence can start with the real subject: 'Subject + is said to + verb'. If the two actions happen at the same time, use the base verb: 'It is said that she sings well.' = 'She is said to sing well.'
teach.zh_hint: 同一句也可以用真正的主詞開頭：主詞 + is said to + 動詞。兩個動作同時發生時用原形：It is said that she sings well.＝She is said to sing well.（據說她唱得很好。）

teach.body: If the reported action happened earlier, use 'to have + past participle': 'It is said that he was a hero.' = 'He is said to have been a hero.'
teach.zh_hint: 如果報導的事發生得比較早，用 to have + 過去分詞：It is said that he was a hero.＝He is said to have been a hero.（據說他曾是英雄。）

teach.body: The actor is said to be very kind. The ship is said to have sunk near the island.
teach.zh_hint: 據說這位演員非常親切（同時→to be）。據說那艘船在島嶼附近沉沒了（較早→to have sunk）。

practice.stem: 改寫同義句（同時發生）：It is said that she sings well. → She is said ____ well.

distractor_rationales.sing: be said 後面要接不定詞 to sing，不能直接接原形 sing。
distractor_rationales.singing: be said to 後面接不定詞，不是動名詞 singing。
distractor_rationales.to have sung: to have sung 表示「較早」；這裡兩件事同時，用 to sing。

practice.feedback: 同時發生用 to + 原形：She is said to sing well.

practice.stem: 改寫同義句：It is believed that the painting was stolen. → The painting is believed ____ .

distractor_rationales.to be stolen: to be stolen 表示「現在被偷」；原句是較早的事（was stolen），要用 to have been stolen。
distractor_rationales.to steal: 畫是「被偷」的一方（被動），不能用主動 to steal。
distractor_rationales.stolen: 少了 to have been；be believed 後面要完整的不定詞。

practice.feedback: 較早＋被動＝to have been + 過去分詞：to have been stolen（據信較早時被偷）。

practice.stem: 填入正確動詞（that 子句）：It is said that he ____ very rich.（據說他很有錢。）

distractor_rationales.to be: that 子句裡要用有時態的動詞（is），不定詞 to be 用在 He is said to be 這種結構。
distractor_rationales.being: that 子句需要一個完整的述語動詞，being 不能單獨當述語。
distractor_rationales.been: been 要配 have；that 子句這裡用 is。

practice.feedback: that 子句裡要有時態動詞：It is said that he is very rich.

practice.stem: 改寫同義句（較早）：People say that he was a famous actor. → He is said ____ a famous actor.

distractor_rationales.to be: to be 表示「現在是」；原句用 was（較早），要用 to have been。
distractor_rationales.being: be said to 後面接不定詞，不是 being。
distractor_rationales.was: be said 後面要接不定詞，不能接有時態的 was。

practice.feedback: 較早的事用 to have + 過去分詞：He is said to have been a famous actor.

practice.stem: 填入正確的形式主詞：____ is said that the bridge is very old.

distractor_rationales.That: 這個句型固定用 It 當形式主詞，不用 That 開頭。
distractor_rationales.There: There is/are 用來表示「存在」，不用在報導說法的句型。
distractor_rationales.Which: Which 是疑問詞／關係詞，不能當這個句型的形式主詞。

practice.feedback: 固定用形式主詞 It：It is said that the bridge is very old.

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 朗讀練習（不產音檔、不自動判讀）：出聲讀句子，注意 is said to be、is said to have been 這些片語連著唸；一邊讀一邊想「這是同時發生，還是較早發生」。

lines.text: The actor is said to be very kind to his fans.
The old ship is said to have sunk near the island long ago.
